propuesta.prompt: @image1 is a real photo of assorted gourmet sushi board at a modern Japanese restaurant. Use it only as the list of elements, not as a layout to copy. The new photograph must contain the same real elements: four seared salmon nigiri with caramelized foie gras and glaze, four uramaki drenched in pale-green creamy sauce with sesame, four tuna rolls topped with tartare, one yellow pansy flower, on a light blonde wooden board. Exactly four salmon nigiri, four sauce uramaki, four tuna rolls, and one edible flower. Nothing else added. New composition by a professional food photographer: low-angle three-quarter view at 20 degrees, 85 mm lens at f/4, wooden board cutting diagonally from bottom-left toward center, leaving clean negative space in upper-right for typography. Hard studio flash from the side with short crisp shadows and glossy specular highlights, warm salmon orange and neutral timber tones. Photographic realism, no text.
